verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers IMAP/POP/SMTP support for accessing Gmail from other clients and API capabilities, but contains no mention of Gmail's actual import-mail-and-contacts feature or any migration tool for bringing in complete mail history/contacts from another provider. Missing for 10: evidence of a dedicated import wizard, POP-based fetch-from-other-account feature, or contacts import tool, and any documentation of completeness/history depth of such an import.
